settings.label: Car name
settings.description: Name of the tuned car in the game's car list (display_name of the .moddedcarcontent file written by the build).

settings.label: Variant name
settings.description: Name of the car's preset/variant (text in en.cars.loc written by the build). Where exactly the game shows it is not confirmed.

settings.label: Displayed power
settings.description: Power value on the car's spec sheet (car_specs POWER of the mechanical preset). Display text only, it does not change the engine: use power_scale for that. The file stores the unit as HORSEPOWER_US.

settings.label: Displayed torque
settings.description: Torque value on the car's spec sheet (car_specs TORQUE of the mechanical preset). Display text only, it does not change the engine.

settings.label: Rev limiter
settings.description: Engine rev limiter (EngineData.limiter). The engine cuts power when it reaches this speed. The stock value also appears in nominal_rpm, which is not changed.

settings.label: Idle rpm
settings.description: Lowest engine speed (EngineData.minimum). Assumed to be the idle/stall speed, not confirmed in the game.

settings.label: Power scale
settings.description: Multiplies the torque value of every point of the engine power curve. 1.0 is stock, 1.056 is about +20 hp.

settings.label: Final drive ratio
settings.description: Final drive ratio. A higher number shortens every gear: stronger acceleration, lower top speed.

settings.label: Gear 1 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 1st gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 2 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 2nd gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 3 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 3rd gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 4 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 4th gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 5 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 5th gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 6 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 6th gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.
